Each fixture/maps is created and accessed by exactly one test thread; even parallel test creates one fixture inside each Callable. LinkedHashMap preserves controlled enumeration and allows deliberately null negative values; no shared mutable map.
JDK-only proxy must implement exact pinned HttpServletRequest interface under its defining loader; no J2EE container/context loader. Correct loader prevents cross-loader incompatibility.
Proxy Object.equals invocation handler intentionally defines identity equality proxy==arg; calling proxy.equals would recursively reenter handler, so value-equality rule is inapplicable.
Host JUnit own2worker8task, every10second join/try-resource pool; no managed servlet/J2EE production threads.
